```{r}

library("readr")

wpolten <- read_delim("datasets/Olten_Waypoints/Waypoints.csv", ",")



library(sf)

wpolten_sf <- st_as_sf(
  wpolten,
  coords = c("X", "Y"),
  crs = 2056, remove = FALSE)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(wpolten_sf)+
  geom_sf()

```
